releasePlan.notes: Gates the pre-game callsign login overlay. control path (flag off): login screen never shown, existing GALACTIC DEFENDER start overlay shown immediately, any saved callsign is silently restored in the HUD. v1 path (flag on): ENTER CALLSIGN overlay shown after LD SDK init, callsign stored in localStorage under 'galactic-defender-player', LD context re-identified to callsign for per-player flag targeting. No prerequisites — feature is orthogonal to invaders-shooter-sprite. Note: when flag is off, LD context stays anonymous-player so per-player invaders-shooter-sprite targeting is inactive; expected control behavior.
